experimental_design.evidence: inferred: EBV-B cells from a human patient homozygous for an W580S mutation in MALT1 were analyzed by TMT10-plex TAILS and compared to EBV-B cells from heterozygous subjects under resting and PMA/ionomycin stimulation for 2 and 4 h.
